title: Foundation-1 procedure-proof test times out its 10s hook under full-suite load
description:
`packages/core/test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/foundation1ProcedureProof.test.ts`
fails with `Error: Hook timed out in 10000ms` when run as part of the full
Vitest suite, and passes (43/43) when its file is run alone.

INDEPENDENTLY ESTABLISHED AS PRE-EXISTING, 2026-09-12: reproduced on a clean
detached checkout of `origin/main` at `67e0653` with no other changes —
`npm run test` there reports `1 failed | 296 passed | 2 skipped`, the same
file, the same hook timeout. It arrived with PR #545 / the Foundation-1
importer stage, not with PR #543.

WHY IT MATTERS
It is a false red on the pre-commit gate and on `main` itself. An agent that
takes it at face value either chases an unrelated change or learns to ignore a
failing gate.

LIKELY CAUSE (unverified)
A `beforeAll`/`beforeEach` hook that builds or loads importer output. Under
full-suite load (one worker per file) that work exceeds the default 10s hook
timeout; alone it does not.

CANDIDATE FIXES, in preference order
1. Raise the hook timeout for that file to reflect the real cost of the setup
   it performs. The assertions are about procedure projections, not speed.
2. Hoist the shared setup so it is paid once per suite rather than per hook.
3. Only if neither holds: give the file a dedicated pool.

Do NOT fix it by skipping the file or weakening its assertions — it is the
permanent evidence for the Foundation-1 procedure-projection work.

RELATED
A sibling pre-existing flake is filed for
`packages/cli/test/cli.test.ts > packs publishable tarballs` (same shape: a
10s timeout under full-suite load, green standalone).
